name: 17233 · Mc Connellsbg, PA
findings: ZIP 17233 (Mc Connellsbg) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 17233 (Mc Connellsbg) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
